legal.title: Legal
legal.impressumText:
Flyary — Digital logbook for paragliding pilots

Responsible:
Tobias Bolliger
Email: info@flyary.ch
legal.privacyIntro: Protecting your personal data is important to us. Below we inform you about how your data is collected and used.
legal.dataCollectionText: We store the data you enter in the app: email address, profile information, flight data, locations, and group information.
legal.dataUsageText: Your data is used solely to provide the app's features. No data is shared with third parties for advertising purposes.
legal.dataStorageText: Data is stored on secure servers in the EU and transmitted encrypted.
legal.rightsText: You have the right to access, correct, and delete your personal data at any time. Contact us through the app.
legal.contactText: For privacy-related questions, please contact the app operator.
legal.termsIntro: These terms govern the use of Flyary, operated by Tobias Bolliger as a private individual.
legal.termsScopeText: Flyary is a digital flight log for paragliding pilots. Use is voluntary and at your own risk.
legal.termsAccountText: You are responsible for the security of your account and the accuracy of the data you enter.
legal.termsLiabilityText: Flyary is NOT a navigation or safety system. Flight planning, weather assessment and safety decisions are solely the pilot's responsibility. We accept no liability for damages arising from use of the app, displayed weather data or maps.
legal.termsContentText: You retain all rights to your uploaded content (photos, tracks, comments). You grant Flyary the right to store and display them within the app's features.
legal.termsTerminationText: You can delete your account at any time via settings. All your data will then be permanently removed.
legal.termsLawText: Swiss law applies. Place of jurisdiction is the operator's residence.
legal.licensesIntro: Flyary uses numerous open-source libraries. We thank the maintainers for their work.

terms.title: Marketplace rules
terms.intro: Before you create your first listing, please confirm these rules:
terms.rule1: I describe condition, age, checks and repairs truthfully.
terms.rule2: I mark equipment that is no longer airworthy as "For parts / not airworthy".
terms.rule3: Flyary only connects people. The sale is between buyer and seller; responsibility for details, condition and airworthiness lies with the two of us.
terms.rule4: Listings can be reported and hidden by the moderators; misuse can get me banned.
terms.privateSaleClause: Private sale: the equipment is sold as seen. Any warranty is excluded as far as the law allows.
terms.sectionRole: In the marketplace, signed-in people and flight schools offer or look for equipment. Flyary only provides the platform and is not a party to any contract. Purchase, payment and handover take place directly between buyer and seller.
terms.sectionResponsibility: Whoever creates a listing is responsible for its details, in particular condition, age, checks, repack dates and repairs. Responsibility for the airworthiness of the equipment lies with seller and buyer. We recommend having second-hand equipment checked by a professional before the first flight.
terms.sectionForbidden: Not allowed are in particular: false or misleading details, unairworthy equipment without the corresponding note, stolen goods, offensive content, listings unrelated to paragliding, and requests for payment in advance to strangers.
terms.sectionModeration: Listings can be reported. The moderators (Flyary, and flight school moderators for private listings) can hide listings. Flyary can ban people from the marketplace for misuse and delete listings.
terms.sectionSchools: Flight schools sell commercially. They state company, address, contact and warranty; VAT-registered schools also their UID number. Sales by schools are covered by their warranty terms.
terms.sectionData: Listings are visible to all signed-in people. "Share" creates a link that lets people without Flyary view an active listing – without the names of private sellers and without a way to contact them; messages are only possible in Flyary. Photos of sold, hidden or long-expired listings are deleted automatically, as are abandoned drafts. Deleting your account removes your own listings and their photos; chats remain readable for the other party.
